result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it adds Vendor indemnities for third-party IP claims, legal violations, Vendor-caused data incidents, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct; protects Customer and its Affiliates; includes standard notice, control, cooperation, and settlement procedures; and narrows Customer’s indemnity to Customer-provided materials and Customer’s legal violations. The IP exclusions and remedies are expressly contemplated by the fallback and do not materially undermine the broader preferred protection. The changes are targeted and professionally drafted, with unrelated commercial intent preserved.
